stages.report:
FALSIFIED
The belief that buying ETH/USDT at the open of every Monday and selling at the close beats random 1-day entries is falsified on the tested past data.

What was tested
Buy ETH/USDT at the open when dow() == 0 and sell at the close of the same day, 2017-08-17 to 2026-10-29. n_trades = 480, avg_bars_held = 1.0, exposure = 0.14.

Strongest evidence against
Random-entry baseline failed. Rule mean net = -0.26% per trade vs random-entry mean -0.04%. The rule beat 12% of 2000 random sets, one-sided p = 0.878. Median net = -0.41%, win_rate = 0.44, total_net = -82.1%, max_drawdown = -89.5%. Buy and hold over the same window returned 646.1%. Fee and slippage sensitivity failed: at 0.25% per side mean trade is -0.56%. Time split failed: -0.02% (n=240) then -0.51% (n=240). Cross-asset failed: better than random on 0 of 9 other assets.

What held up
Sample size pass: 480 completed trades from 480 signals. Look-ahead guard pass. Multiple testing pass: first sealed belief about ETH/USDT, no correction needed. Neighbourhood pass: 0 of 1 nearby variants point the same way.

What would change the verdict
A pre-registered mean net return that beats random entries with the same 1-day holding period at alpha 0.05, with min_trades 20, on the specified window.

Caveats
Falsify tests beliefs about the past. It is not investment advice and makes no prediction.
